source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB SEL reservation; meaningful only within an approved bounded follow-on workflow.

source_snapshot.deepseek: YES raw reservation with password argv.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Treats stateful reservation as a standalone read.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires purpose, lifetime, concurrency, ID parsing and release/expiry proof.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No indefinite reservation or destructive follow-on.

original_test_intent: Acquire and validate a SEL reservation for one bounded approved dependent operation, then prove release or expiry.
original_method: Send Storage 0x0A/0x42 and capture the two-byte reservation ID.
manual_activity: Repository owner approves the dependent operation, reservation lifetime and contention boundary.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Bytes are directionally correct but standalone execution lacks purpose and lifecycle controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Acquire one reservation only immediately before an approved bounded workflow and prove it ends.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw command, Script and timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind reservation ID, owner, dependent command and expiry evidence in one transaction record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds state ownership and lifecycle acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A returned ID alone does not prove safe/useful reservation behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Contention or stale ownership can invalidate other workflows.

project_override_considerations: A library-managed reservation is equivalent only if ID, owner, lifetime, cancellation and dependent-operation evidence remain visible.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and command align; lifecycle is missing but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reservation semantics are clear; purpose/lifetime are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents an orphaned reservation and makes ownership, use and expiry auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reservation is coordination state, not a display/read test. Its validity depends on a specific subsequent operation and repository generation; therefore acceptance requires a parsed ID plus bounded ownership and observed cancellation/expiry, without repeatedly reacquiring on contention.
